messages.subject: removing borders from grid.arrange
parts:
I am trying to combine two graphs into one one graph using gridExtra package's grid.arrange function. I am doing this:
 
p1<-ggplot(x, aes(Date, Value)) + geom_line()
p2<-ggplot(y, aes(Date, Score)) + geom_point()
grid.arrange(p1, p2)
 
when I do this, I get borders around p1 and p2. Is there a way to disable them, not show them?
